name: I Have Known You
source:
The life of MC is turned upside down after he moves to his hometown, Wildflower. Soon, the dreamy summer days start turning into a nightmare as MC discovers he is not welcome there.
Unaware of the dark and dangerous past of the town, MC soon finds himself drawn into a world of shocking secrets about Wildflower and its residents.​

[From F95Zone]
